name: Wildwood Berry Farm
description: Wildwood Berry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 977 Mad Tom Rd, VT. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
